artworks.title: Pigeon Tower (La tour aux pigeons)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees and a cylindrical stone structure. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, obscuring the horizon with foliage and the structure. The style features fine cross-hatching for textures of trees and the structure, creating depth. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of black and white. Textured grounds slope upwards towards trees and the stone structure. The signature "A. Legros" is in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Fording a River (Le gue)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a figure on a horse drinking from a body of water. The background includes a line of dense foliage and trees, with an arched bridge in the distance. Fine, detailed brushstrokes are used to depict textures and depth, with cross-hatching for shading. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of sepia and brown, creating a contemplative atmosphere.

artworks.title: Banks of the Oise (Bord de l'Oise)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a low horizon. In the foreground, a person stands by the water holding a fishing rod. Tall trees with intricate textures and curvy lines dominate the scene, providing depth. More trees are visible in the distance, sketched with lighter strokes. The etched lines vary in density, with darker strokes for the closer trees and lighter lines for those further away. The artwork's monochromatic palette focuses on shading and line work. The sky is muted, contributing to the atmospheric quality. The composition showcases the interplay of light and shadow through various textures.

artworks.title: Cardinal Manning, 2nd plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person's head and upper shoulders seen in a side profile. The person is seated or upright, facing left, with distinct facial features including a prominent nose and deep-set eyes. They have a high forehead with sparse hair pulled back under a small cap. The individual appears older with angular features, visible cheekbones, and a defined jawline. They are wearing a simple robe loosely draped around the shoulders and neck. The background is plain, emphasizing the detailed sketch of the figure.

artworks.title: Tolstoy
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is an engraving of a man from the shoulders up. He has a long, full beard and wavy hair. The man is looking downward with a contemplative expression, wearing a robe with textured details on the shoulders. The background is plain with no additional elements.

artworks.title: H.W. Longfellow, 2nd plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of an elderly man in a three-quarter view, with his body slightly turned to his right. His facial features are detailed, with deep-set eyes, prominent cheekbones, and a long, full beard. The man has long, flowing hair and is dressed in simple attire. The drawing is monochromatic, with soft lines and shading. There are no visible jewelry or objects, and the background is minimal.

artworks.title: Valley of Dunes (La vallee des dunes)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with fields, settlements, and rolling hills. The detailed etching depicts the land and foliage using fine lines. The monochrome color palette emphasizes the intricate detailing and creates depth. In the foreground, two figures are carrying bundles amidst shrubbery and terrain. In the background, there is a village with small structures, a church spire, trees, farmland, and a river.

artworks.title: Mushroom Gatherers (Les ramasseurs de champignons)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts an etched landscape with a horizon positioned in the upper third of the composition. Distant clusters of trees and bushes fill the scene, while cloud formations on the right side of the sky are etched with fine, parallel lines. Intricate foliage and bushes are depicted using detailed lines for texture and movement. The color palette lacks strong contrast, creating a monochromatic aesthetic typical of etching. Varying density and direction of lines suggest depth and texture in the natural elements of the landscape.

artworks.title: Trees at Water's Edge (Les arbres au bord de l'eau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a body of water with trees on the horizon. The scene features trees, a rowboat, and a figure in the boat.

artworks.title: Shepherd's Hut on a Hillside  (Bergerie sur le coteau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a hut to the right and two trees on the left. The sky fills the top half of the picture, while the land and hut take up the lower half. The hut has a thatched roof and wooden planks. The trees have thin branches, adding contrast to the horizontal layout. The etching technique creates texture and depth in the image. The color scheme is monochromatic with black, gray, and beige tones. A path runs between the trees and the hut, leading towards the horizon in the distance.

artworks.title: Large Sacrifice to Priapus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 23 x 16.8 cm (9 1/16 x 6 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a group of people in a classical or historical setting. In the foreground, two women are standing, one leaning against a pillar or tree trunk, and the other holding a child. An older man with a beard and curly hair is sitting in the middle background, and another figure stands behind him. A vase with plants is in front of them on a raised platform. The background shows a tree and a simple architectural structure.

artworks.title: The Conversion of Saint Paul
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 28.9 x 41 cm (11 3/8 x 16 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of soldiers traveling through a rocky landscape with horses and hunting dogs. There are soldiers in armor, some on foot and others on horseback, moving through the rugged terrain. In the foreground, two hunting dogs walk alongside the soldiers. The background includes dense foliage on a cliffside, a distant structure resembling a fortress, and atmospheric clouds with light rays breaking through. The scene captures the movement and determination of the traveling army, with detailed character expressions and rendering of clothing, armor, and weaponry.

artworks.title: Altarpiece with the Beautiful Virgin of Regensburg and Saints Christopher, Mary Magdalene, Florian, and Catherine Standing in Niches, with God the Father Above
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate religious altar. The drawing features a central figure that appears to be of religious significance, surrounded by smaller angelic figures. This central character is framed within a grand, architecturally detailed altar structure complete with arches, columns, and intricate decorative elements including floral motifs and geometric patterns. On either side of the central figure, at different levels, are additional figures that seem to be seated or standing within niches, each of them surrounded by distinctive arch designs. The architectural design is highly symmetrical, showcasing classical elements such as pediments and detailed cornices along with elaborate ornamentation.

artworks.title: Christ as the Man of Sorrows
artworks.description: This is a painting of a central figure surrounded by scenes contained in circular frames. The painting depicts a central figure seated, with distinct wounds and a crown, surrounded by ornate architectural elements and a series of circular vignettes that each contain different scenes. The central figure has a somber and contemplative expression, sitting on a structure adorned with columns. Surrounding this figure are eight circles, each illustrating different narrative scenes, with multiple figures engaged in various activities. The artwork uses a palette dominated by earth tones, with touches of red, blue, and yellow providing visual emphasis to particular details. The edges of the paper are weathered. The work is elaborately detailed with intricate linework and shadowing that add depth to the composition. This is in the style of Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: Saint John
artworks.medium: tempera and gold leaf on vellum
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scribe in a decorated manuscript. The painting shows a seated figure in a blue robe with a halo, writing on a scroll with a quill at a writing desk. The scene is framed with a rich architectural arch, and the surrounding page is decorated with vibrant red, blue, and gold floral motifs and filigree. The text in red and black script occupies a central portion below the artwork, set within fields of colorful flourishes. This is in the style of medieval illuminated manuscript art.

artworks.title: Saint Luke
artworks.medium: tempera and gold leaf on vellum
artworks.description: This is a painting of an illuminated manuscript page featuring a seated figure. The illuminated manuscript page shows an elegantly dressed figure sitting in an architectural setting with a wooden desk, chair, and a vibrant green tiled floor. The figure is engaged in writing or reading, with a book resting on the lectern. Next to the figure, there is a winged bull. The scene is surrounded by intricate floral patterns in vivid blues, reds, and golds, and the page contains gothic script text at the bottom. The elaborate decoration is typical of the ornate style found in medieval manuscripts.

artworks.title: Saint Mark
artworks.medium: tempera and gold leaf on vellum
artworks.description: This is a painting of an illuminated manuscript page featuring botanical motifs and an illustration of a robed figure with a lion. The border is filled with vibrant flowers, leaves, birds, and insects in blue, red, and green. In the central illustration, a robed figure with a halo is seated, engaged in writing or reading from a manuscript. A lion sits at their feet. The artwork is framed with gothic text in the lower portion of the page. It is in the style of medieval manuscript illumination, reminiscent of Flemish or French styles from the late Middle Ages or early Renaissance.

artworks.title: Saint Matthew
artworks.medium: tempera and gold leaf on vellum
artworks.description: This is a painting of an illuminated manuscript page featuring vibrant floral motifs and figures at a writing desk. The central scene shows two individuals seated and standing at a writing desk, surrounded by colorful floral designs in the margins. These details include blue, orange, and red flowers, with vines and tendrils across the page. The scene within the frame features a dimly lit room with one person seated on a chair, engaged in writing or reading, while the other is standing behind a desk. The style reflects the traditions of medieval manuscript illumination, with attention to decorative elements and color.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher
artworks.artist: Master of the Dutuit Mount of Olives
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a medieval-style illustration. The larger figure is carrying the smaller figure on their shoulders. The larger figure has a beard and wears a draped garment with blue and gold fabric, while the smaller figure holds a globe with a cross on top and has short hair and a halo. Both figures are surrounded by a decorative frame with floral and vine patterns in green and red, against a parchment-like background. The larger figure holds a staff and they are moving through a wavy pattern suggestive of flowing water.

artworks.title: Carrack, Heading to the Right
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a sailing ship. The drawing depicts a sailboat with large sails unfurled, shown from a side angle. The vessel has a tall mast with a crow's nest and a flag at the top. The hull is drawn with detail, showcasing the curvature of the ship and the planks that make up its construction. A figurehead is visible at the bow of the ship, and the water is represented with flowing lines to suggest movement. The line work is delicate and precise, capturing the grandeur and complexity of the historic ship.

artworks.title: Saint Lawrence
artworks.description: The image shows a half-length portrait of a person seated slightly angled to the left, with their head leaning in the same direction. The person has a calm expression, slightly downturned eyes, and wavy, light brown hair. They are dressed in a richly patterned green garment with gold detailing and a blue border around the neckline. The garment has intricate patterns and a prominent motif on the chest. The person's right hand is holding a slender, rod-like object against a gold background. The background features gold leaf and an elaborate border with red, green, and blue acanthus leaves and floral motifs encircling the central figure.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: This painting depicts a crucifixion scene in the style of medieval illuminated manuscripts. Above the illustration, there is text written in Latin, adorned with red and black ink on a parchment-like background. The central figure is affixed to a cross with arms outstretched, head tilted downwards. Two other figures with halos stand on either side of the central figure, one in a blue robe with hands together, and the other in a blue robe holding a rounded object. The background is painted in shades of blue, orange, and green with decorative patterns.

artworks.title: Emperor Maximilian I
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in green printed from two blocks
artworks.description: The image shows a mounted knight in ornate armor on a horse. The knight holds a lance and wears a full-face helmet with decorations. The armor is detailed, and the knight sits confidently. The horse is also armored, and both have matching coverings. The background has architectural elements, emblems, and an inscription reading “IMP-CAES-MAXIMIL-AVG.”

artworks.title: The Lovers Surprised by Death
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from 3 blocks: black line block and 2 tone blocks in shades of red on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure standing over a fallen figure in a detailed architectural setting. The foreground presents a scene where a winged being gestures with one hand towards a stone wall or an altar on the left, while the other hand appears to be supporting a limp, armored figure lying on the ground. The attire and wings suggest a spiritual or mythological theme. Surrounding the scene, the architecture is ornate, with arches, columns, and sculpted details adorning the surroundings. The technique involves fine lines and shading, providing texture and depth, while a limited palette emphasizes the dramatic tone and enhances the focus on the central figures.
